info.name: Jira Clone API
info.description:
Jira Clone - a Jira-like project and task tracker. Every endpoint is documented once, with
its inputs and a saved example for each response it can return (open the Examples dropdown on any
request).

BASE URL
`{{base_url}}` defaults to `http://localhost:5000` - the backend started by `docker compose up -d --build`.

AUTHENTICATION
Bearer `{{access_token}}` is set once on the collection and inherited by every request. Register,
Login and Refresh use No Auth. Tokens are saved automatically by the login and refresh requests.

GETTING STARTED
1. Set `email`, `password` and `full_name`, then send **Register**.
2. Send **Login (step 1)**, then **Login (step 2)**. With `auto_totp` = `true` the 6-digit code is
   computed from the saved `totp_secret`; set it to `false` to type the code from an authenticator app.
3. Create a project, then work down the folders. Requests save the ids they create
   (`project_id`, `task_type_id`, `task_id`, `comment_id`, `activity_id`). `user_id` is you
   (saved by Register and Me). Set `member_id` to another user's id (see **List users**) to add them
   to a project.
4. The Delete requests remove the row whose id is saved, so send them last.

BODIES
Request bodies carry a `// required` or `// optional` comment with the type on every field. Postman
strips the comments before sending. Id fields (`project`, `type`, `assignee`, `users`) are sent as
JSON integers. Query parameters are listed on each request; optional ones are unticked.

ERRORS
Standard DRF shape: field errors keyed by field name (`{"title": ["This field is required."]}`),
other errors under `detail`. `401` means a missing or invalid access token. `404` is returned
instead of `403` when you are not a member of the project.

request.description:
Create an account. Email is the login; there is no username.

**Auth:** none.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `email` | string (email) | Yes | Unique, stored lowercased. Max 254. |
| `full_name` | string | Yes | Max 150. |
| `password` | string | Yes | Write-only. Min 8 characters, not common, not entirely numeric. |

Any other field (e.g. `job_title`) is ignored. The password is never returned.

**Responses:** `201` the new user `{id, email, full_name}` · `400` field errors.

response.name: 201 Created
400 Invalid input

exec: const b = pm.response.code < 300 && pm.response.text() ? pm.response.json() : null;

request.description:
Check email and password. This never returns tokens: two-factor (TOTP) is mandatory on every
login. It returns a short-lived `pending_token` (5 minutes) to send to **Login (step 2)**.

**Auth:** none.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `email` | string | Yes | Case-sensitive match against the stored (lowercased) email. |
| `password` | string | Yes |  |

Two `200` shapes:
- `totp_setup_required`: no authenticator linked yet. Carries `secret` (base32) and `otpauth_uri`;
  render the URI as a QR code or type the secret into the app. The secret is only ever shown here.
- `otp_required`: an authenticator is linked; just ask for the 6-digit code.

**Responses:** `200` pending token · `400` missing fields · `401` wrong email or password (same body
either way).

The script saves `pending_token` and, on first login, `totp_secret`.

response.name: 200 TOTP setup required (first login)
200 TOTP code required (device linked)
400 Missing fields
401 Wrong email or password

exec: const b = pm.response.code < 300 && pm.response.text() ? pm.response.json() : null;

request.description:
Exchange the pending token plus the current 6-digit authenticator code for the token pair.
The first successful verify links the authenticator; later logins return `otp_required`.

**Auth:** none.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pending_token` | string | Yes | From step 1. Valid for 5 minutes. |
| `code` | string (6 digits) | Yes | Keep it quoted so leading zeros survive. Valid only in its 30-second window. |

**Responses:** `200` `{refresh, access}` · `400` wrong code · `401` expired or malformed pending token.

With `auto_totp` = `true` the pre-request script fills `{{totp_code}}` from `totp_secret`. The
script saves `access_token` and `refresh_token`.

response.name: 200 Signed in
400 Wrong code
401 Expired or invalid pending token

exec: // When auto_totp is 'true' and totp_secret is set, {{totp_code}} is generated here, so no phone
// is needed. Set auto_totp to 'false' to type the code from your authenticator app instead.
const b = pm.response.code < 300 && pm.response.text() ? pm.response.json() : null;

request.description:
Get a new access token. Refresh tokens rotate: the response carries a new `refresh` too, and
the one you sent is blacklisted and cannot be used again.

**Auth:** none.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `refresh` | string | Yes | The current refresh token. |

Access tokens last 60 minutes, refresh tokens 7 days.

**Responses:** `200` `{access, refresh}` · `400` missing field · `401` invalid, expired, wrong-type or
already-used token.

response.name: 200 New token pair
400 Missing refresh
401 Blacklisted or invalid token

exec: const b = pm.response.code < 300 && pm.response.text() ? pm.response.json() : null;

request.description:
Revoke a refresh token. The access token keeps working until it expires on its own, so the
client should discard both.

**Auth:** Bearer access token.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `refresh` | string | Yes | Must be the caller's own, still-valid refresh token. |

**Responses:** `204` no body · `400` invalid, already revoked, or someone else's refresh token ·
`401` missing or invalid access token.

response.name: 400 Invalid refresh token
401 Not authenticated

query.description: optional - email | full_name | created_at (prefix - to reverse)

request.description:
The user directory, used to pick members and assignees. Paginated.

**Auth:** Bearer access token.

| Parameter | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `search` | string | Matches email or full name; every word must match. |
| `email` | string | Exact email, case-insensitive. |
| `project` | integer | Only members of this project id. |
| `ordering` | string | `email`, `full_name`, `created_at`; prefix `-` for descending. Default `id`. |
| `page` | integer | Page number, from 1. |
| `page_size` | integer | Default 20, max 100. |

Rows are `{id, email, full_name, job_title, avatar}` (`avatar` is an absolute URL or `null`). There is no per-user detail endpoint.

**Responses:** `200` `{count, next, previous, results}` · `401`.

response.name: 200 OK
401 Not authenticated

request.description:
The signed-in user's own profile.

**Auth:** Bearer access token.

Returns `{id, email, full_name, job_title, avatar, created_at, updated_at}`.

**Responses:** `200` · `401`.

request.description:
Edit your own profile. Every field is optional; send only what changes. Send as
`multipart/form-data` when uploading an avatar (plain JSON works for the text fields).

**Auth:** Bearer access token.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `full_name` | string | No | Max 150, not blank. |
| `job_title` | string | No | Max 100. Empty string clears it; never null. |
| `avatar` | file | No | JPEG, PNG or WEBP, max 10 MB. Send it empty to remove the picture. Replacing deletes the old file. |

`email` and `id` are read-only and ignored.

**Responses:** `200` the updated profile · `400` field errors · `401`.

formdata.description: optional - file: JPEG, PNG or WEBP, max 10 MB. Enable and pick a file to upload.

request.description:
Summary counts and recent tasks for the signed-in user, across every project they belong to.

**Auth:** Bearer access token.

| Parameter | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | How many `recent_tasks` to return. Default 10, `0` for none. |
| `created_after` | datetime (ISO 8601) | Only count tasks created at or after this time. |
| `created_before` | datetime (ISO 8601) | Only count tasks created at or before this time. |

`stats` holds `active_projects`, `assigned_tasks`, `reported_tasks`, `overdue_tasks` and
`tasks_by_status` (all five statuses). `recent_tasks` are tasks assigned to you, newest first.

**Responses:** `200` · `400` bad `limit` or date · `401`.

response.name: 200 OK
400 Invalid query
401 Not authenticated

request.description:
Projects you are a member of. Paginated.

**Auth:** Bearer access token.

| Parameter | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `search` | string | Matches name, key or description. |
| `name` | string | Name contains this text, case-insensitive. |
| `status` | string | `active`, `done` or `archived`. Repeat for several. |
| `owner` | integer | Owner user id. |
| `ordering` | string | `created_at`, `updated_at`, `name`, `key`, `status`, `task_count`, `open_task_count`; prefix `-` for descending. Default `-created_at`. |
| `page` | integer | Page number. |
| `page_size` | integer | Default 20, max 100. |

Rows carry `task_count` and `open_task_count` (tasks not `done`) and the `owner`.

**Responses:** `200` `{count, next, previous, results}` · `400` invalid filter · `401`.

request.description:
Create a project. You become its owner. It starts `active` and is seeded with the task types
Bug, Feature, Task and Improvement.

**Auth:** Bearer access token.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | Yes | Max 120. |
| `key` | string | Yes | 2-10 letters or digits, starting with a letter. Uppercased by the server. Unique, and cannot change later. |
| `description` | string | No | Default empty. |
| `members` | integer[] | No | User ids to add as members. Write-only, create-only. Your own id is ignored. One bad id rejects the whole request. |

**Responses:** `201` the project with its `members` · `400` field errors · `401`.

The script saves `project_id`.

response.name: 201 Created
400 Invalid input
401 Not authenticated

exec: const b = pm.response.code < 300 && pm.response.text() ? pm.response.json() : null;

request.description:
One project with everything in it: owner, members with roles, all task types and all tasks.
Your own role is the `role` of your row in `members`.

**Auth:** Bearer access token.

**Responses:** `200` · `401` · `404` unknown id, or you are not a member.

response.name: 200 OK
401 Not authenticated
404 Not found or not a member

request.description:
Edit a project. Owner only. Every field is optional; send only what changes.

**Auth:** Bearer access token.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | No | Max 120. |
| `description` | string | No |  |
| `status` | string | No | `active`, `done` or `archived`. An archived project is read-only; the owner can only set its status back. |
| `key` | string | No | Immutable: only the current key is accepted. |

`members` is not accepted here; use **Project members**.

**Responses:** `200` the project with its `members` · `400` field errors · `401` · `403` not the owner,
or the project is archived · `404` unknown id, or you are not a member.

response.name: 200 Updated
400 Invalid input
401 Not authenticated
403 Not the owner
404 Not found or not a member

request.description:
Delete a project and all its tasks. Owner only; not allowed while archived.

**Auth:** Bearer access token.

**Responses:** `204` · `401` · `403` not the owner, or archived · `404` unknown id, or you are not a member.

response.name: 401 Not authenticated
403 Not the owner
404 Not found or not a member

request.description:
Everyone in the project, owner included. Not paginated.

**Auth:** Bearer access token.

| Parameter | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `role` | string | `owner` or `member`. |
| `search` | string | Matches member email or name. |
| `ordering` | string | `joined_at` or `role`. |

Rows are `{user, role, joined_at}`.

**Responses:** `200` · `401` · `404` unknown project, or you are not a member.

response.name: 200 OK
401 Not authenticated
404 Project not found or not a member

request.description:
Add users to the project in one request. Owner only. All-or-nothing: one unknown, repeated or
already-member id rejects the whole list. New members get role `member`.

**Auth:** Bearer access token.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `users` | integer[] | Yes | User ids. Not empty. |

**Responses:** `201` the new memberships · `400` invalid list · `401` · `403` not the owner, or the
project is archived · `404` unknown project, or you are not a member.

response.name: 201 Created
400 Invalid users
401 Not authenticated
403 Not the owner
404 Project not found or not a member

request.description:
One membership, addressed by the member's **user id**.

**Auth:** Bearer access token.

**Responses:** `200` `{user, role, joined_at}` · `401` · `404` not a member of this project.

response.name: 200 OK
401 Not authenticated
404 Not a member

request.description:
Remove a user from the project, by user id. Owner only. Their tasks in this project become
unassigned.

**Auth:** Bearer access token.

**Responses:** `204` · `400` the owner cannot be removed · `401` · `403` not the owner, or archived ·
`404` not a member of this project.

response.name: 400 Cannot remove the owner
401 Not authenticated
403 Not the owner
404 Not a member

request.description:
The project's task types. Returns the first **5** by default, for pickers. Not paginated.

**Auth:** Bearer access token.

| Parameter | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer or `all` | How many rows. Default 5, `all` for every type, `0` for none. |
| `name` | string | Name contains this text, trimmed, case-insensitive. |
| `search` | string | Every word must appear in the name. |
| `is_active` | boolean | `true` or `false`. |
| `ordering` | string | `name`, `created_at` or `task_count`; prefix `-` for descending. Default `name`. |

Rows are `{id, project, name, is_active, task_count, created_at}`.

**Responses:** `200` · `400` bad `limit` · `401` · `404` unknown project, or you are not a member.

The script saves the first row as `task_type_id`.

request.description:
Add a task type. Owner only.

**Auth:** Bearer access token.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | Yes | Max 50, trimmed. Unique in the project, case-insensitive, inactive types included. |
| `is_active` | boolean | No | Default `true`. |

**Responses:** `201` · `400` blank or duplicate name · `401` · `403` not the owner, or archived ·
`404` unknown project, or you are not a member.

The script saves `task_type_id`.

| `is_active` | boolean | No | `false` hides it from new tasks; existing tasks keep it. |

**Responses:** `200` · `400` blank or duplicate name · `401` · `403` not the owner, or archived ·

Delete a task type that no task uses. Owner only. A type in use must be deactivated instead
(`is_active: false`).

**Auth:** Bearer access token.

**Responses:** `204` · `400` type is in use · `401` · `403` not the owner, or archived · `404` unknown type.

request.description:
Tasks in projects you are a member of. Not paginated. Newest first by default.

**Auth:** Bearer access token.

| Parameter | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | integer | Project id. |
| `project_key` | string | Project key, case-insensitive. |
| `status` | string | `todo`, `in_progress`, `in_review`, `qa_review`, `done`. Repeat for several. |
| `type` | integer | Task type id. |
| `assignee` | integer | Assignee user id. |
| `reporter` | integer | Reporter user id. |
| `unassigned` | boolean | `true` for tasks with no assignee. |
| `mine` | boolean | `true` for tasks you reported or are assigned to. |
| `created_after / created_before` | datetime (ISO 8601) | Creation window, inclusive. |
| `due_after / due_before` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | Due-date window, inclusive. |
| `search` | string | Matches title, description or key. |
| `ordering` | string | `created_at`, `updated_at`, `due_date`, `status`, `title`, `key`; prefix `-` for descending. |

Rows include the nested `project`, `type`, `reporter`, `assignee` and `allowed_statuses`.

**Responses:** `200` · `400` invalid filter · `401`.

response.name: 200 OK
400 Invalid filter
401 Not authenticated

request.description:
Create a task in a project you belong to. You become its reporter. It starts at `todo` and
gets a key like `SHOP-1`.

**Auth:** Bearer access token.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | integer | Yes | A project you are a member of. |
| `title` | string | Yes | Max 200. |
| `type` | integer | Yes | An active task type of the same project. |
| `description` | string | No | Default empty. |
| `assignee` | integer or null | No | A member of the project. |
| `due_date` | string (YYYY-MM-DD) or null | No |  |

`status`, `key` and `reporter` are set by the server and ignored if sent.

**Responses:** `201` · `400` field errors (including a project you are not in) · `401` · `403` the
project is archived.

The script saves `task_id`.

body.raw:
{
  "project": {{project_id}},   // required - integer, project id
  "title": "Checkout button does nothing on Safari",   // required - string, max 200
  "type": {{task_type_id}},   // required - integer, active task type of the same project
  "description": "Clicking Pay shows no spinner.",   // optional - string
  "assignee": {{user_id}},   // optional - integer user id (project member) or null
  "due_date": "2026-10-15"   // optional - string YYYY-MM-DD or null
}

request.description:
Edit a task. Every field is optional; send only what changes. The reporter may change any
field; the assignee may change only `status`.

**Auth:** Bearer access token.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | No | Max 200. Reporter only. |
| `description` | string | No | Reporter only. |
| `type` | integer | No | Active task type of the same project. Reporter only. |
| `assignee` | integer or null | No | A project member, or null to unassign. Reporter only. |
| `due_date` | string (YYYY-MM-DD) or null | No | Reporter only. |
| `status` | string | No | `todo`, `in_progress`, `in_review`, `qa_review`, `done`. See the rule below. |

Status permission depends only on the destination:
- reporter: `todo`, `done`
- assignee: `in_progress`, `in_review`, `qa_review`
- reporter who is also the assignee: all five
- anyone else, the project owner included: none

`allowed_statuses` on every task lists what **you** may set. Re-sending the current status is always
accepted.

Each changed field is recorded in the task's activity.

**Responses:** `200` · `400` field errors, or a status you may not set (lists `allowed_statuses`) ·
`401` · `403` not allowed to edit this task, or archived · `404` unknown id, or you are not a member.

}
